responsibility: Implements the forward jump-thread discovery engine for tree SSA. It maintains temporary SSA-name equivalences and ranges while symbolically traversing edges and PHIs, simplifies statements and terminal conditions with folding, available-expression facts, and EVRP/range information, identifies potentially threadable blocks and outgoing edges, and records jump-thread paths through blocks for later CFG/SSA rewriting by the threadupdate machinery.
same_name_distinction: This .c file is the jump-thread discovery engine: it records temporary equivalences from PHIs and edges, simplifies statements and control conditions along candidate paths, and registers threadable paths for later application. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-threadedge.h, it does not just define the jump-threader/jt_state interfaces and shared SSA_NAME value-tracking declarations.
